commonPlatforms.Infinity: Top tier - communicating system with Greenspeed variable speed compressor. Uses Infinity Touch thermostat. Error codes on thermostat display.
commonPlatforms.Performance: Mid-tier - two-stage options available. Standard thermostat compatible.
commonPlatforms.Comfort: Entry level - single stage. Builder grade.

knownIssues: Infinity systems: thermostat firmware updates can fix intermittent issues - check carrier.com for latest
Older 24ACC units: evap coil leaks due to formicary corrosion (covered under extended warranty on some serial ranges)
Greenspeed compressor: requires specific Carrier-approved refrigerant oil
WeatherArmor protection: don't remove top panel for cleaning - use coil cleaner through fins
Carrier.warrantyNotes: Standard: 10-year parts (must register within 90 days, otherwise 5-year). Compressor: 10-year. Heat exchanger: 20-year or lifetime depending on model.
Carrier.modelNumberDecoder: Example: 24ACC636A003 → 24=residential, ACC=model series, 6=SEER tier, 36=36000 BTU (3 ton), A=revision, 003=config

commonPlatforms.XV: Premium - variable speed compressor. Communicating with ComfortLink II.
commonPlatforms.XR: Mid-tier - single or two-stage. Good efficiency.
commonPlatforms.XB: Entry level - single stage, builder grade.

knownIssues: Climatuff compressor scroll: extremely reliable but when they fail, they fail hard (grounded windings)
Older XR13/XR15 units: TXV issues - check sensing bulb mounting first
Spine-fin condenser coil: very efficient but harder to clean - use low-pressure rinse only
ComfortLink communicating systems: require Trane-specific dealer tools for advanced diagnostics
Trane.warrantyNotes: Registered: 10-year parts + 12-year compressor. Unregistered: 5-year base. CleanEffects air cleaner: 10-year.
Trane.modelNumberDecoder: Example: 4TTR6036J1000A → 4=residential, TTR=model, 6=SEER tier, 036=36000 BTU, J=revision, 1000=config, A=voltage

commonPlatforms.Signature (SL): Premium - variable speed. iComfort smart thermostat integration.

knownIssues: Aluminum evap coils (introduced ~2015): some early runs had formicary corrosion leaks - check for extended warranty coverage
iComfort thermostat: wifi connectivity issues - firmware update often resolves
Older pulse furnaces (1980s-90s): unique design, parts scarce - recommend replacement
EL18XCV: inverter drive boards are expensive ($1500+) - check warranty first
Micro-channel condenser coils: efficient but fragile fins, harder to repair leaks
Lennox.warrantyNotes: Registered: 10-year parts. Some models: limited lifetime heat exchanger. Unregistered: 5-year.

knownIssues: Older Goodman units (pre-2012): lower build quality reputation, but post-Daikin acquisition improved significantly
Copeland scroll compressors used in most models - very reliable
Known for competitive pricing - good value, slightly lower SEER than premium brands at same price point
Older R-22 units: check for TXV with non-bleed port - causes issues on startup
Amana brand has LIFETIME compressor warranty (if registered) - significant selling point
Goodman.warrantyNotes: Goodman registered: 10-year parts. Amana: LIFETIME unit replacement warranty on some models (must be registered). Unregistered: 5-year.

commonPlatforms.M-Series: Residential single-zone ductless. Most popular mini-split in North America.
commonPlatforms.City Multi (VRF): Commercial variable refrigerant flow. Multi-zone large buildings.
commonPlatforms.H2i Hyper-Heat: Cold climate heat pump - rated to -13°F. Full heating capacity at 5°F.

knownIssues: Communication wiring is polarity-sensitive (S1, S2, S3 terminals) - wrong polarity = E1 error
Drain pump failure common on MSZ-GL models - pump reservoir gets algae buildup
Indoor PCB: static discharge can damage - always ground yourself before touching
kumo cloud WiFi adapter: ensure firmware is current for reliable connectivity
Branch box on multi-zone: check electronic expansion valves individually when one zone underperforms
Mitsubishi.warrantyNotes: Registered via Diamond Contractor: 12-year parts + compressor. Standard: 5-year parts, 7-year compressor.
Mitsubishi.diagnosticTool: MELCloud or Mitsubishi diagnostic tool (MHK2) can pull detailed fault history from indoor unit memory.

commonPlatforms.Fit: Premium residential - slim profile, inverter compressor, R-32 refrigerant.
commonPlatforms.VRV: Commercial variable refrigerant volume. Competing with Mitsubishi City Multi.
commonPlatforms.One+: Unique modular heat pump + gas furnace combo.

knownIssues: Daikin Fit: uses R-32 - different service procedures than R-410A (slightly flammable A2L)
VRV systems: require Daikin Intelligent Equipment software for diagnostics and commissioning
R-32 systems require specific recovery equipment rated for A2L refrigerants
One+ system: hybrid heat pump + gas - complex dual-fuel logic, needs proper thermostat setup
Daikin.warrantyNotes: Registered: 12-year parts. Unregistered: 5-year. VRV: varies by project.
Daikin.r32Notes: R-32 is becoming the standard replacement for R-410A. Lower GWP. Mildly flammable (A2L). Same pressure range as R-410A but slightly higher efficiency. Requires R-32-rated gauges and recovery machines.

commonPlatforms.Prestige (RA20/RP20): Top tier - variable speed inverter compressor with EcoNet smart system integration. Communicating system with diagnostic data streaming.
commonPlatforms.Classic Plus (RA17/RP17): Mid-tier - two-stage scroll compressor, good efficiency, EcoNet-compatible.
commonPlatforms.Classic (RA14/RA16/RP14): Standard line - single-stage, reliable workhorse units, widely available parts.

knownIssues: Some 2013-2018 evaporator coil drain pans: cracking issue causing water leaks - check for extended service bulletin coverage
EcoNet smart system: occasional WiFi connectivity drops, app slowness - firmware updates resolve most issues
Older Classic series furnaces: secondary heat exchanger condensate corrosion in high-humidity climates
Prestige inverter boards: sensitive to power surges, surge protection strongly recommended
Pre-2010 units: silicon carbide ignitors fail more frequently than SiN replacements - upgrade when servicing
Overall reputation: solid mid-market reliability, parts widely available, fair pricing on components
Rheem.warrantyNotes: Registered: 10-year parts standard, 10-year compressor. Some Prestige units: lifetime compressor (residential, original owner). Unregistered: 5-year base. Heat exchanger: 20-year or lifetime varies by model.
Rheem.modelNumberDecoder: Example: RA1748AJ1NA → RA=A/C residential, 17=SEER tier, 48=48000 BTU (4 ton), AJ=revision/config, 1=phase, NA=region. Ruud equivalent uses UA prefix for same units.
Rheem.diagnosticTool: EcoNet app for smart-equipped units provides fault codes and historical data. Rheem Pro Partner Portal accesses service bulletins and diagnostic info.

commonPlatforms.Affinity YXV/YZV: Top tier - variable-speed modulating inverter compressor with communicating controls. Best efficiency in lineup, up to 26 SEER2.
commonPlatforms.Affinity YP9C/YXT: Premium two-stage scroll - high efficiency, communicating capable with Hx3 thermostat.
commonPlatforms.Sunline (commercial): Commercial RTU line - 3-25 ton capacities, common in light commercial work.

knownIssues: Older Affinity boards (2008-2014): communicating thermostat compatibility issues, board failures common at 8-10 year mark - $400-700 replacement
Simplicity Smart Equipment commercial RTUs: communication module failures, wired BACnet preferred over wireless
Pre-2012 evaporator coils: formicary corrosion issues on some models - check serial number against extended warranty bulletin
YXV inverter drives: surge sensitivity - factory recommends whole-home surge protection
Strong commercial/industrial line - strong dealer network for commercial, residential dealer network thinner in some regions
Coleman/Luxaire are essentially identical units rebranded for independent dealer channels
York.warrantyNotes: Registered: 10-year parts + 10-year compressor (residential). Unregistered: 5-year. Some Affinity: limited lifetime compressor with registration. Commercial units: typically 1-year parts + 5-year compressor with extended options.
York.modelNumberDecoder: Example: YXV60B36S21 → YXV=Affinity variable speed, 60=SEER2 nominal, B=revision, 36=36000 BTU, S=split system, 21=voltage/config code
York.diagnosticTool: York RFC (Residential Field Communicator) tool for Affinity systems. UPGNet portal for service bulletins. Simplicity SE app for commercial Sunline units.

commonPlatforms.IDS Premium Connected: Top tier - inverter ducted split heat pump, up to 20.5 SEER2, cold-climate capable to -4 degrees F, EasyAir thermostat communicating.
commonPlatforms.IDS 2.0: Standard inverter ducted split - very efficient, quiet, mid-tier price point.
commonPlatforms.BOVA / BOVB: Inverter air-source heat pump compact line - emerging product family.
commonPlatforms.Greentherm tankless water heaters: Companion product line - separate product category from HVAC.

knownIssues: Inverter board failures: relatively expensive ($1200+), limited stocking dealers - parts lead time can be 1-3 weeks
Proprietary diagnostic procedures: not all aftermarket techs are familiar - factory service training strongly recommended
Limited dealer network: compared to Carrier/Trane/Lennox, fewer authorized dealers - service in rural areas can be challenging
EasyAir thermostat communication: requires specific wiring (4-conductor minimum), not interchangeable with standard 24V thermostats without bypass kit
Some early IDS units (2018-2020): firmware bugs causing inverter shutdown in extreme conditions - update available via authorized tech
Refrigerant: uses R-410A on most current models, R-32 transition starting 2025-2026
Generally very efficient and quiet operation - reliability when properly serviced is excellent
Bosch.warrantyNotes: Registered: 10-year parts + 10-year compressor. Some IDS Premium models: lifetime compressor with registration. Standard: 5-year parts/compressor unregistered.
Bosch.modelNumberDecoder: Example: BOVA-36HDN1-M20G → BOVA=model series, 36=36000 BTU, HDN1=heating designation, M20G=configuration/voltage.
Bosch.diagnosticTool: Bosch Service Tool (BST) - proprietary handheld diagnostic for inverter systems. Required for advanced fault codes and parameter adjustments. EasyAir app provides limited end-user diagnostics.

commonPlatforms.Art Cool Mirror / Gallery: Premium decorative wall-mount ductless - mirrored or framed art-display fronts, popular high-end residential.
commonPlatforms.LSN/LSU Standard Series: Standard single-zone ductless wall-mount units - good value, ThinQ smart integration.
commonPlatforms.Multi F / Multi F MAX: Multi-zone ductless - up to 8 indoor units on single outdoor condenser.
commonPlatforms.Multi V (VRF): Commercial variable refrigerant flow - competes with Mitsubishi City Multi and Daikin VRV. Multi V 5 latest residential-friendly version.
commonPlatforms.LGRED cold climate: Hyper-heating designation - rated heating to -13 degrees F (5 degrees F sustained at full capacity).

knownIssues: CH05 error: communication failure between indoor and outdoor units - check polarity and continuity of communication wire (typically 14-gauge stranded)
CH21 error: high-pressure compressor protection - check refrigerant overcharge, blocked condenser, or DC fan motor failure
CH38 error: outdoor temp sensor fault - typically thermistor failure on outdoor coil ($30-50 part)
CH07 error: indoor unit operation mode mismatch on multi-zone systems - all indoor units must operate same mode (heat OR cool, not both) on standard heat-pump multi-zones
Drain pump on Art Cool units: prone to algae buildup, requires annual cleaning
Inverter PCB on outdoor units: surge-sensitive, surge protection required for warranty in some cases
Multi V VRF: requires LG-certified design and commissioning - improper line set sizing causes oil return issues
Communication wire: must be shielded twisted-pair for runs over 100ft to avoid interference
Thermistor failures more common than competitors - keep thermistor kit on truck for LG service calls
LG.warrantyNotes: Registered: 10-year compressor + 5-year parts (residential ductless). Multi V: 10-year compressor + 1-year parts standard, extended packages available.
LG.modelNumberDecoder: Example: LAN120HYV1 → L=LG, AN=Art Cool wall-mount indoor, 120=12000 BTU (1 ton), HY=heat pump high efficiency, V1=voltage/revision. Outdoor: LAU120HYV1 (matched outdoor unit).
LG.diagnosticTool: LGMV (LG Monitoring View) - PC-based diagnostic software connecting via service port on outdoor PCB. Provides real-time data for pressures, temps, EEV positions, compressor frequency. Essential for Multi V troubleshooting. LG Air Solution mobile app for ThinQ-equipped residential units.

Heil.parentCompany: Carrier Global (International Comfort Products / ICP division)

commonPlatforms.Ion (HVA9/HVH9): Top tier - communicating variable-speed compressor, equivalent to Carrier Infinity but through independent dealer channel.
commonPlatforms.QuietComfort Deluxe (HCA6/HCH6): Mid-tier - two-stage scroll with Qujet two-stage compressor. Strong sound performance.

knownIssues: Essentially Carrier/Bryant equipment with different model numbering - same compressors, coils, and major components, distributed through independent dealers
Ion communicating systems: same Infinity Touch protocol as Carrier - thermostats and controls cross-compatible in most cases
Service parts often listed under both Carrier and ICP part numbers - cross-reference saves time
Qujet two-stage compressors: essentially Copeland Ultratech - same servicing as standard Copeland scrolls
Earlier 2010-2013 N-series furnaces: secondary heat exchanger corrosion on some serial ranges - check service bulletin
Often more competitively priced than Carrier brand for identical equipment
Heil.warrantyNotes: Registered: 10-year parts + 10-year compressor (residential). Unregistered: 5-year. Heat exchanger: 20-year or lifetime depending on model. Same warranty terms as Carrier-branded equivalents.
Heil.modelNumberDecoder: Example: HVA9361B → H=Heil, VA=variable-speed A/C, 9=9th tier (Ion), 36=36000 BTU, 1=phase, B=revision. Tempstar/Comfortmaker use TVA/NXA prefixes for equivalent units.
Heil.diagnosticTool: ION System Control thermostat provides on-screen fault codes for Ion systems (same interface as Carrier Infinity Touch). Standard Carrier diagnostic tools work on Heil/ICP equipment.

commonPlatforms.Platinum (AccuComfort variable speed): Top tier - modulating inverter compressor, AccuLink communicating with Gold/Platinum 1050 thermostat. Identical to Trane XV20i.
commonPlatforms.Gold (Two-Stage): Mid-tier - two-stage scroll compressor, communicating capable. Equivalent to Trane XR/XL line.
commonPlatforms.Silver (Single-Stage): Standard single-stage - reliable, good value. Equivalent to Trane XR13/XR14.
commonPlatforms.AccuClean Whole-Home Air Cleaner: Add-on electronic air cleaner with 99.98% particle removal - compatible with all American Standard furnaces and air handlers.

knownIssues: Same equipment as Trane - sold through independent dealer channel rather than Trane factory dealer network
Climatuff scroll compressors: same as Trane - extremely reliable, but when they fail they fail hard (grounded windings most common)
Spine-Fin condenser coil: same proprietary coil design as Trane - low-pressure rinse only, never pressure wash
AccuLink communicating thermostats: cross-compatible with Trane ComfortLink systems - same protocol
Older Platinum 824/850 thermostats (2014-2018): WiFi connectivity issues - firmware updates available
AccuClean cells: collect dirt requiring quarterly cleaning - skipped maintenance reduces airflow and efficiency
Pricing typically slightly lower than Trane-branded equivalents through dealer channel - same equipment quality
American Standard.warrantyNotes: Registered: 10-year parts + 12-year compressor (Platinum), 10-year compressor (Gold/Silver). Unregistered: 5-year base. AccuClean: 10-year. Identical warranty structure to Trane.
American Standard.modelNumberDecoder: Example: 4A7V0036A1000A → 4=residential, A7V=AccuComfort Platinum variable speed, 0036=36000 BTU, A1000A=revision/config. Letter codes parallel Trane's 4TTV/4TTR system.
American Standard.diagnosticTool: AccuLink Platinum 1050 thermostat displays system fault codes and diagnostic data. American Standard dealer portal for service bulletins. Trane TEM diagnostic tools work identically on American Standard equipment.
